notes: Table 1: HbA1c percent, tirzepatide 15 mg (N 45) baseline and week 28 vs placebo (N 28); change comparison p below 0.001 | STUDY: NCT03951753, phase 1 multicentre randomised double blind parallel arm mechanism of action trial (28 weeks) in adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, BMI 25 to 45, randomised 3:3:2 to tirzepatide 15 mg weekly (maintenance from week 20, dose_mg 15), semaglutide 1 mg weekly (from week 8, dose_mg 1) or placebo, 117 randomised (45, 44, 28); this post hoc exploratory report (Mather 2025) prints Table 1 with baseline and week 28 mean plus or minus SD per arm for HbA1c, triglycerides, leptin and adiponectin with exact p values for the pairwise change comparisons (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; the p values are recorded in the notes, not used); both active arms are entered against the shared placebo arm (rows carry the drug, receptor class, dose and n); biomarkers are exploratory (prespecified FALSE); pct_weight_change from the Table 1 means, tirzepatide 94.2 to 83.4 kg, minus 10.8 kg equals minus 11.5 percent (semaglutide 92.7 to 85.3 kg, minus 8.0 percent; placebo 98.7 to 97.9 kg, minus 0.8 percent; no contrast printed); the primary report (Heise 2023) is the companion; funded by Eli Lilly (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low
